seeded.note: Candidates seeded from a research agent's web-search summaries (see data/leads); unverified until the contest file cites the Secretary of State certified list. No stance questions set yet. Research notes: SoS unofficial primary returns: Fong 68.4%, Sandra Van Scotter (D) 28.6%, Ben Dewell (NPP) 1.8%, Jeremy Fox (NPP) 1.2%. Fong: Wikipedia gives his birth as October 24, 1979, in Bakersfield (not a primary source). Ballotpedia labels the seat CA-30 in one place, which appears to be a typo. Fong's Assembly district numbers were not retrieved. Van Scotter: the KGET questionnaire gives her age as 56 and hometown as Chicago. A Kern County candidate list of uncertain date (possibly an earlier election) shows the description Disability Community Advocate; it is not confirmed as her November 2026 designation. Van Scotter education not found.
